author: Pat-co

title: Old version
body: I liked the older version better… the problem with this version is that it won’t let me see the description for my lists. Every time i click on the description, It only lets me write but won’t let me see what i had previously written. Its really frustrating so if this doesn’t change i might need to find a new app to write things down in.
author: skip my puppy

title: Excellent app to help keep you focused, organised & proactive
body: I am loving TimeFinder. It took me a while to customise it to how I liked it, but I’m so glad I continued refining it despite finding it overwhelming & a bit challenging for the first few days. It was so worth it. My days are more structured and intentional now, and I can easily see how I can swap or move events or tasks when flexibility is needed. I feel calmer as a result of being more organised & proactive. I highly recommend!
author: _Alison__

title: Just not worth the price
body: Unfortunately as someone with diagnosed ADHD don’t see the benefit of the app. The app itself is very clunky to use with a confusing list for a tutorial. For $49.99NZDfor a year, I’m still better off just using my calendar.
author: Officiallydan
